fields.description: The UTC time at which the event was logged.
fields.name: timestamp

fields.description: Indicates the type of event being logged (e.g., 'LLM_REQUEST', 'TOOL_COMPLETED').
fields.name: event_type

fields.description: The name of the ADK agent or author associated with the event.
fields.name: agent

fields.description: A unique identifier to group events within a single conversation or user session.
fields.name: session_id

fields.description: A unique identifier for each individual agent execution or turn within a session.
fields.name: invocation_id

fields.description: The identifier of the user associated with the current session.
fields.name: user_id

fields.description: The event-specific data (payload). Format varies by event_type.
fields.name: content

fields.description: Populated if an error occurs during the processing of the event.
fields.name: error_message

fields.description: Indicates if the content field was truncated due to size limits.
fields.name: is_truncated
